goal_and_scope: Test robustness claims against a resource-bounded interface before treating near-redundancy as approximate classicality.
inherited_inputs: source-status distinctions in current Astra wrappers
acquired_inputs: self-contained construction and proof in this session
representation_and_assumptions: Copies are supplied, not cloned; large Hilbert space; globally correlated outputs; no small global idempotence defect
exact_missing_lemma: A resource-bounded, experimentally accessible version would require a new theorem or construction; none is supplied.
comparator: Common physical EB map or common diagonal family, not a nonphysical virtual broadcast map.
falsifier_or_next_experiment: Reconstruct the exact proof under the target branch input/cost contract; do not transfer a conclusion after dropping its assumptions.
unresolved_or_UNKNOWN: no efficient algorithm or practical experiment
status_note: Author-internal proof with finite checks; not external or formal certification.
